QUOTE: `entropic_inference_count_tokens` (`src/inference/inference_c_api.cpp:548-560`) returns 0 on tokenizer failure. Its doc comment promises a `text_len/4` estimate "on error," but that estimate is only used on the exception path. A caller budgeting context would see a zero-token prompt and could overfill the context.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the token-counting path returns 0 on tokenizer failure instead of signalling an error.
